title: Inhale
summary: INHA'LE, verb transitive [Latin inhalo; in and halo, to breathe.] To draw into the lungs; to inspire; as, to inhale air; opposed to exhale and expire. Martin was walking forth to inhale the fresh bree

inlines.v: INHA'LE, verb transitive [Latin inhalo; in and halo, to breathe.] To draw into the lungs; to inspire; as, to inhale air; opposed to exhale and expire. Martin was walking forth to inhale the fresh breeze of the evening.
